name: ranger_slide_floor
description: Ranger swing-slide S3 (L=550). EXACT WB geometry. Teleport to S3 (419,200), attach grapple to (960,100), pendulum free-fall to floor, Circle-slide, release-boost.
script: # === B+C. Teleport to S5 start, THEN attach grapple ===
# Use S5 (L=750) — longest rope, gives maximum slide distance before taut.
# Attach grapple to ceiling hook (960,100) with rope=750.
# Distance from (217,200) to (960,100) ≈ 750. Rope is TAUT.
# Pendulum starts at rest, swings from far left to floor and beyond.
announce Ranger at S5 (217,200). Grapple TAUT to (960,100). L=750.
# Will trigger slide the moment pendulum reaches the floor.
announce Circle HELD. Pendulum released from rest — swinging to floor.
# === E+F. Free-fall on pendulum — no input ===
# The arc hits the floor at ~(583, 500) — the S3 floor intersection.
announce Pendulum should be near floor. Checking...
# Circle is held — slide is active, charge building.
# Release quickly before rope pulls player off surface.
